theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) tailored for Tactical Utility
theme_and_archetype.description: A highly functional, precision-focused aesthetic. Uses deep obsidian/matte charcoal backgrounds with a striking 'Safety Yellow' accent. It evokes the feeling of a high-end Braun calculator or professional photography equipment. No generic teal or purple gradients.

rules.hero_text: Must use tight letter spacing. Do not use generic sans-serif for the hero amount. The Per-Person amount is the most important element on the screen.
rules.labels: Overlines and small labels should be uppercase with wide tracking for tactical readability.

shadows.none: Use 1px solid borders instead of shadows for a flat, tactical look.

hero_display.description: Top section showing the final 'Per Person' split. Massive, high-contrast numbers.

bill_input.description: Secondary display just below hero. Shows total bill amount.

keypad.description: Custom numerical keypad filling the lower-mid screen. Grid layout. No background per key, just large precise text, possibly separated by 1px subtle borders (border_collapse style).

tip_chips.description: Horizontal scrollable list or tight grid of tip percentages (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, 25%, Custom).
tip_chips.style: Surface background, 1px border. Selected state gets Safety Yellow border and text.

action_buttons.description: CTAs for features like 'Scan Receipt' and 'Add People'. Must be prominent but not outshine the primary data.

bottom_sheets.description: Used for Receipt Scan and Named People list. Replaces standard modals. Slides up from bottom.

toggles.description: Switches for 'Round up' and 'Split Type (Even vs Named)'.

interactions.haptics: MANDATORY. Every keypad press, chip selection, and person addition must trigger a light haptic feedback.
interactions.animations: Use react-native-reanimated for layout transitions (e.g., when switching from simple number to named people list).
interactions.sheet_transitions: Bottom sheets must have a smooth spring animation.

media.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons). Do not use emojis.

receipt_placeholder.description: Placeholder for receipt scanning view background or scanning simulation

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo project. Use pure React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity) and StyleSheet for styling, do NOT use HTML tags (div, span).
The codebase uses .js files, so avoid TypeScript syntax.
For the custom keypad, use a flat 3x4 grid structure. It must update the state instantly.
Implement bottom sheets using @gorhom/bottom-sheet or a custom animated View.
Use expo-haptics to add physical feedback to the calculator.
Ensure all data-testids are added exactly as specified in the guidelines for QA automation. In React Native, map these to 'testID' props.
All text colors must explicitly contrast against the dark background. Do not rely on default system text colors.
Ensure offline-first approach via AsyncStorage for 'last split memory' and 'last group of names'.
